# Setup
```{r}
#| label: Load Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)

source(here("Code/Functions/blocked_cv_by_site.R"))
source(here("Code/Functions/split_density_plot.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: Set Theme
theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 20), # overall text size
      legend.text = element_text(size = 20), # legend entries
      legend.title = element_text(size = 20), # legend title
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # axis titles
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # axis titles
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20), # axis tick labels
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank()
    )
)
```

# Load RF Data
```{r}
site_meta <- read_csv(here("Data/site_meta.csv")) |>
  arrange(lon) |>
  mutate(
    Site = fct_reorder(Site, lon),
    name = fct_reorder(name, lon),
    kg_name = fct_reorder(kg_name, lon)
  ) |>
  relocate(Site, name, kg_name)

rf_data <- read_csv(here("Data/best_lags_rf_data.csv")) |>
  relocate(Site, name, kg_name, Date, Cluster)
```

# Blocked CV by Site
```{r}
#| label: Blocked CV

folds <- rf_data |>
  mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = site_meta$Site)) |>
  arrange(Site, Date) |>
  blocked_cv_by_site(Site, v = 5)

folds |>
  mutate(
    n_assess = map_int(splits, \(s) nrow(assessment(s))),
    n_sites = map_int(splits, \(s) n_distinct(assessment(s)$Site))
  )

folds |>
  mutate(
    range = map_chr(splits, function(s) {
      d <- assessment(s)
      paste(format(range(d$Date)), collapse = " to ")
    })
  ) |>
  select(id, range)

fold_long <- map2(folds$splits, folds$id, function(s, nm) {
  s$data |>
    mutate(
      fold = nm,
      role = if_else(row_number() %in% complement(s), "Testing", "Training"),
      role = factor(role, levels = c("Training", "Testing"))
    )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

folds |>
  mutate(
    n_train = map_int(splits, \(s) nrow(analysis(s))),
    n_test = map_int(splits, \(s) nrow(assessment(s))),
    total = n_train + n_test,
    pct_train = 100 * n_train / total,
    pct_test = 100 * n_test / total
  ) |>
  select(id, n_train, n_test, pct_train, pct_test)

fold_long |>
  count(fold, Site, role) |>
  group_by(fold, Site) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(role == "Testing") |>
  select(fold, Site, n_test = n, pct_test = pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = fold, values_from = c(n_test, pct_test))

ggplot(fold_long, aes(x = Date, y = fct_rev(fold), color = role)) +
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Site) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Training = "#85898A", Testing = "#0051BA")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL, title = "Blocked CV by Site")

ggsave(
  filename = "blocked_cv_by_site.png",
  path = here("Figs/Supplement/"),
  device = "png",
  width = 40,
  height = 20,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600
)

split_density_plot(fold_long, "Blocked CV by Site", fold_col = "fold")
ggsave(
  filename = "blocked_cv_by_site_dens.png",
  path = here("Figs/Supplement/"),
  device = "png",
  width = 40,
  height = 20,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600
)
```
